caption: A baseball is struck high into the outfield and comes down onto the grass far from where it was hit.

sa.check: It goes high into the outfield.
It comes down onto the grass.
It lands far from where it was hit.
The hit comes first, then the flight, then the landing.

pc.expect: The ball follows one long smooth arc, its forward motion continuing until it lands.
pc.fail: The ball flies flat at a constant height; or it hangs at the top; or it changes direction in mid-air with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: It slows near the top and then falls steadily to the grass.
pc.fail: The ball rises again after starting to fall; or it levels off and glides; or it drops straight down from the peak with no forward travel.

pc.expect: Nothing touches the ball in flight.
pc.fail: The ball speeds up in mid-air; or it jinks sideways; or it stops and restarts.

pc.expect: The ball hits the grass and bounces or rolls low, flattening the grass.
pc.fail: The ball bounces higher than its flight; or it sinks into the ground; or it splashes.

pc.expect: One ball is in play throughout.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes in flight or a second one appears; or it turns into another object; or it passes through the ground.

pc.expect: The ball, the field markings and the outfield stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour in flight; or the field lines shift between frames; or the outfield wall rearranges.
